# remote_shell_tool

> Run allowlisted shell commands on a remote code workspace via SSH.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `developer` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=remote_shell_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Run allowlisted shell commands on a remote code workspace via SSH.

Use this tool ONLY for running tests, linters, build tools, and other executables.
Do NOT use this tool for file editing — use remote_file_tool instead (it supports
read, write, and patch operations).

Only commands in the workspace's allowed_commands list can be executed. This prevents
arbitrary command execution while allowing necessary development tools.

Default allowed commands: bundle, rspec, rubocop, rake, yarn, npm, node, npx, pytest, pip, make, git

The allowed list is configurable per workspace via workspace_config.allowed_commands.

EXAMPLES:

Run tests:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", command: "bundle", args: ["exec", "rspec", "spec/models/user_spec.rb"]}

Run linter:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", command: "rubocop", args: ["app/models/"]}

Install dependencies:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", command: "bundle", args: ["install"]}

Run a make target:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", command: "make", args: ["build"]}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_slug` | string | yes | Workspace slug identifying which remote server to connect to. |
| `command` | string | yes | Command to run (must be in workspace allowed_commands list) |
| `args` | array of string | no | Command arguments. |
| `timeout` | integer | no | Command timeout in seconds (max 300) |
